rationales: Guessing does not systematically break a problem into smaller parts.
Acting it out simulates a problem rather than dividing it into smaller problems.
Prototyping creates an early model of a solution rather than decomposing the problem.
Divide and Conquer breaks a complex problem into smaller, manageable problems.
A flowline shows the direction and sequence of steps in a flowchart.
A terminal symbol marks the start or end of a flowchart.
A processing symbol represents an operation or instruction.
A connector links separated parts of a flowchart.
0010₂ represents hexadecimal 2, not A.
1010₂ is the binary equivalent of hexadecimal A.
0011₂ represents hexadecimal 3, not A.
1111₂ represents hexadecimal F, not A.
Binary is a base-2 number system, not the one used for everyday counting.
Hexadecimal is a base-16 number system, not the usual daily-life system.
Decimal is the base-10 number system commonly used in daily life.
Base 16 is another name for the hexadecimal system.
An IPv4 address does not contain 31 bits.
An IPv4 address does not contain 29 bits.
An IPv4 address consists of 32 binary bits.
An IPv4 address does not contain 30 bits.
The TCP/IP model is commonly described as having four layers.
Three layers is not the standard number of TCP/IP layers.
Five layers is used in some network models, but not the standard TCP/IP model here.
Six layers is not the standard number of TCP/IP layers.
Hacking involves unauthorized access or activity, not specifically making illegal software copies.
Making or distributing unauthorized copies of software is called piracy.
Counterfeiting means making imitation goods or documents, rather than specifically copying software illegally.
Sabotage means deliberately damaging or disrupting something.
Two omits important components of a communication system.
Three may describe a simplified sender-channel-receiver model, but not the standard set of basic data communication components.
The five basic components are sender, receiver, message, transmission medium, and protocol.
Six is not the standard number of basic data communication components.
A USB drive retains data without power, so it is non-volatile.
RAM is volatile memory because its contents are lost when power is switched off.
ROM retains its contents without power, so it is non-volatile.
A hard disk retains data without power, so it is non-volatile.
10000₂ equals 16, not 17.
10110₂ equals 22, not 17.
10001₂ equals 17 in decimal.
10100₂ equals 20, not 17.
<Scr> is not the HTML tag used to insert an image.
<Pic> is not a standard HTML image tag.
<im> is not the standard HTML image tag.
is the HTML tag used to define or insert an image.
A hyperlink is clickable text or content that takes the user to another page or location.
Plain text is not necessarily clickable or linked to another page.
A table arranges information in rows and columns.
HTML is the markup language used to create web pages, not the clickable link itself.
A password is a secret used for authentication, not the name for encrypted data.
Plain text is readable, unencrypted data.
Ciphertext is data after it has been encrypted.
Secret text is not the standard technical term for encrypted data.
A hacker may gain unauthorized access to a computer system.
A network controller manages or monitors network operations, not necessarily illegal access.
A computer operator performs authorized computer tasks.
An authorized person has permission to access the system.
Two is fewer than the commonly taught five steps of the problem-solving process.
Three is fewer than the commonly taught five steps of the problem-solving process.
The problem-solving process is commonly presented in five steps.
Seven is not the number of steps used in this problem-solving sequence.
